name: Service navigation
summary: Use Service navigation beneath the GOV.UK header to show a service name and a small set of service-level navigation links.
whenToUse: Use for a GOV.UK service that needs a visible service name, service navigation links, or both beneath the GOV.UK header.
Keep navigation short and limited to persistent top-level destinations supported by user research.
whenNotToUse: Do not use to reproduce the GOV.UK global header or for page-level tabs and task navigation.
Do not add a menu simply to fill the space when the service has no persistent top-level navigation.

anatomy.name: Service container
anatomy.description: A GOV.UK module and width container align the service bar with page content.

anatomy.name: Service name
anatomy.description: A link identifies and returns to the service home page.

anatomy.name: Navigation landmark
anatomy.description: A labelled nav contains a short list of service destinations.

anatomy.name: Responsive menu toggle
anatomy.description: A hidden-by-default button controls the navigation list on narrow screens after enhancement.

variants.name: Service name only
variants.use: A service needs a clear name but no persistent navigation.

variants.name: Service name and navigation
variants.use: A service has a small set of persistent top-level destinations.

behaviour: Initialise govuk-service-navigation to reveal and operate the responsive menu toggle.
Without JavaScript, navigation links remain visible and usable and the toggle remains hidden.
Mark the current destination with the official current-item option and accessible current-page semantics.
accessibility: Give the nav a concise aria-label that distinguishes it from other navigation landmarks.
Give the toggle an aria-controls value matching the navigation list id.
Do not communicate the current page through styling alone.
content: Use the public service name consistently with the page title and service start page.
Use concise nouns for destinations and avoid duplicating links already provided by the browser or page content.
Do not include GOV.UK global navigation items in this service-level component.
